_comment: Symbols from static/helpers/unreal-sdk/sdk-surface.json that check-unreal-surface.mjs must not report as undocumented. Each real entry is {"id": "<surface id, e.g. UCrowdyTeams::GetMyTeamById or UCrowdySDKDeveloperSettings::AppId>", "reason": "internal|deprecated|mass|editor", "note": "<why a reader does not need it>"}. A settings class id covers every property of that class. Entries without an id, like this one, are ignored.
